decision_criteria: Policy allows certification without material caveats only if no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation exists with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Draft runbooks and future monitoring may support risk management but do not remove a current disclosure requirement unless approved.

Borderline support with overclaim and unresolved required predicates maps to suspicious rather than compliant or compliant_with_caveats.
